PrivateOnly: This bot currently supports private chats only.
AdminOnly: Only channel administrators can use this command.
PersonalClosed: The personal bot is available to Premium users only.
AdminHelp:
Channel admin commands:
/channeladd username - add an X account to the channel
/channelremove username - remove an X account from the channel
/channellist - show the channel watchlist

Premium admin commands:
/premiumadd username - enable Premium for a user
/premiumremove username - disable Premium for a user
/premiumlist - show Premium users

GMGN admin commands:
/gmgnstatus - check the GMGN connection

AI admin commands:
/aistatus - check OpenAI
/aitest post text - create a token draft
/aiimage prompt - create a token image

FLUX admin commands:
/fluxstatus - check FLUX
/fluximage post text - create an image

/tokenpreview post text - preview a token
/language - change language
PersonalHelp:
Personal commands:
Send an X Post link - create a token manually
/add username - add or update an X account
/remove username - remove an X account
/list - show your watchlist
/settings - configure wallet, buy amount and Auto Create
/language - change language
